name: 911 LST Organizer
description: Pulls the .lst files for the parts on a nest's 1D cutting diagram (cross-batch aware) into the nest's PRODUCTION PAPERWORK\LST folder
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Sync the '911 QTDR' folder. Have the nest's PRODUCTION PAPERWORK folder ready - you pick it when the app runs.
That folder needs the nest's 1D cutting-pattern PDF (its name contains '1D'; the '1D POST' post-cut revision is never used).
how_it_works: Pick the nest's PRODUCTION PAPERWORK folder. The app reads the 1D diagram to see exactly which parts that nest cuts.
It finds each part's .lst file (foreign parts are traced back to their own nest by looking on disk, not the PDF header) and copies them in.
A trailing revision letter counts as the same piece, so a part listed as '-3' still matches a file named '-3A' (and vice versa); those swaps are logged and marked on the report.
output: The parts' .lst files gathered into an LST folder under PRODUCTION PAPERWORK, plus a pull-list text file.
A blocking popup if any nests couldn't be found or any .lst files are missing.
